text: At its June 23, 2025 meeting, the TTC Board approved amendments to the TTC’s Authorization for Expenditures and Other Commitments policy, including an increase to the CEO’s delegated authority to award contracts (other than single source) for budgeted goods and services. The CEO’s contract award authority was increased from $5 million CAD to an amount up to the approved budget. The Board’s approval of this increase included a requirement to report back semi-annually on contracts awarded under the delegated authority that exceed $5 million CAD. This report provides the Board with a summary of contracts awarded between June 23, 2025 and December 31, 2025, under the delegated authority.
The Toronto Transit Commission received the Summary of Contract Awards Over $5 million from June 23, 2025 to December 31, 2025 for information.
